item.title: Configuring Browser Proxies and Bypassing Local DNS Restrictions for Sikkim Government Portals
item.description:
Navigating government portals often requires specific network configurations, particularly when local domain names rely on internal National Informatics Centre (NIC) DNS infrastructure. If you are accessing services like the Sikkim DDO Pranali portal (ddo.pranali.sikkim.nic.in) through a proxy setup, misconfigured DNS settings can lead to domain resolution failures or local DNS leaks.

This detailed guide breaks down how to configure system-wide and browser-specific proxies in Firefox and Opera, and how to set up FoxyProxy Standard to safely route NIC DNS traffic.

item.title: Mastering Prompt Engineering: A Complete Guide to Slash Commands & Super Prompts
item.description:
Prompt engineering has evolved from simple text inputs into structured, command-driven workflows. By utilizing slash commands and system-level instructions, you can transform standard AI models into highly specialized tools for document processing, content creation, image restoration, and technical problem-solving.

This guide breaks down every prompt configuration covered in our workflow, showing you how to turn raw ideas into executable, highly efficient AI operations.

1. The Super Prompt Framework System

The foundation of command-driven AI interaction relies on a master framework. By feeding the AI a reference logic sheet at the start of a session, you enable short slash commands to trigger complex output styles, reasoning depth, and formatting guardrails instantly.
